cell.justification: The vendor's own support page dates support for the Team plan to 31 March 2030, more than 12 months out: the level-5 condition.

selectors.exact: The Team plan is supported until 31 March 2030.

missing.note: Retrieval covered the Larkpad website, the Larkpad changelog and two independent review sites and returned no span on how long support for the current plan lasts.

selectors.exact: Business plan customers are supported through December 2029.

cell.justification: The vendor's help centre says every workspace exports to Markdown and JSON, and its API reference documents the open JSON schema: all data in an open, documented format, the level-5 condition.

selectors.exact: Export every workspace to Markdown and JSON; the JSON schema is published in our API reference.
Exports produced by the bulk endpoint are documented in the open Notes Interchange schema, version 2.

cell.justification: The vendor's help centre says notes and folders export to plain Markdown but comments and attachments only as a Mossnote-readable bundle: not proprietary-only (level 3) and not all data in an open format (level 5), so it sits between the two.

selectors.exact: Notes and folders export to plain Markdown. Comments and attachments export only as a .mossarchive bundle, readable by Mossnote.

cell.justification: The vendor's help centre offers a self-serve move with a stated limit: how complete it is depends on the export formats the data supports, so it meets the level-3 condition rather than the unlimited level-5 one.

selectors.exact: You can move your team off Quillbase yourself at any time. How complete the move is depends on the export formats your data supports; see the export guide.
Industry-leading support, there for your team whenever you need it.

missing.note: Searched the Larkpad homepage and press releases. The homepage's only support claim is general, with no statement of how long support for the plan lasts, so nothing places the cell.

cell.justification: The vendor says moving an organisation off is handled by its paid Migration Services team, which meets the level-1 condition; a consultancy adds that a paid engagement is required above 50 seats.

selectors.exact: Moving an organisation off Mossnote is handled by our paid Migration Services team.
Mossnote requires a paid engagement with its own services team to migrate an organisation of more than 50 seats.

cell.justification: The vendor's help centre describes a self-serve migration that carries across only what the export tool can produce: a stated limit, so the level-3 condition rather than the unlimited level-5 one.

selectors.exact: Larkpad's migration assistant moves your workspace without any help from us, and it carries across exactly what the export tool can produce, nothing more.

cell.justification: The vendor's developer docs say every workspace, comments and attachments included, exports as JSON following the published OpenNotes 1.2 schema: all data in an open, documented format, the level-5 condition.

selectors.exact: Every workspace, including comments and attachments, exports as JSON that follows the published OpenNotes 1.2 schema.

selectors.exact: The Team plan is supported until 31 March 2030.
Team plan support has been extended to 30 June 2031.

cell.justification: The vendor's support page commits to support the Team plan for at least two more years: an undated commitment that clears level 3 and falls short of the dated level-5 condition, so it sits between 3 and 5.

selectors.exact: We will support the Team plan for at least two more years.

cell.justification: A review site reports a company representative's verbal remark that the Business plan will be supported through 2032: a dated commitment more than 12 months out, but secondhand and not published by the vendor, so the level-5 condition is graded low.

selectors.exact: Mossnote says it will keep supporting the Business plan through 2032, according to a company rep we spoke to.

cell.justification: The vendor's export documentation says Markdown export is available for every workspace, so it is not proprietary-only (level 3); a JSON export is only planned and nothing says Markdown carries all data, so level 5 is not met and the cell sits between 3 and 5.

selectors.exact: Markdown export is available for every workspace. A JSON export of the same content is planned.

cell.justification: The vendor says its whole workspace exports as a .mnote archive whose format its developer guide describes, with plain Markdown files inside: all data in a documented format; that the container is open is inferred from the public guide, not stated, so the grade is medium.

selectors.exact: Export your workspace as a .mnote archive. The archive format is described in our developer guide and the files inside are plain Markdown.
I think you can export to Markdown from the settings page, but I have not tried it myself.

cell.justification: The vendor's migration guide says most teams move themselves with the export tools, but workspaces over 50 GB get free staff help: a self-serve path with a stated limit, the level-3 condition.

selectors.exact: Most teams move off Quillbase on their own with the export tools. Workspaces over 50 GB are moved with help from our staff, at no charge.

cell.justification: The vendor's migration page offers self-serve export that does not carry comments: a self-serve path with a stated limit, the level-3 condition; its Migration Desk is offered help, not required, so level 1 is not met.

selectors.exact: Our Migration Desk will help you move off Mossnote. Self-serve export is also available, though it does not carry comments.

cell.justification: The vendor's migration assistant moves a workspace in a few clicks with no help needed, but shared links do not move: a self-serve path with a stated limit, the level-3 condition.

selectors.exact: Our migration assistant moves your workspace in a few clicks. It does not move shared links, which break on leaving.
